entry.title: PoliPlug 1.5.3
entry.summary: Effect rack: up to 16 of your installed effects in series plus a parallel section, each with its own skin and presets **Fixed in 1.5.3:** with an effect whose skin was made by another tool installed (for example the Argevox Gerät vocoder), PoliPlug showed only that effect's skin on every page, so the rack couldn't be used. Effects from any skin generator now show only on their own page. (Details: #1) **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **

entry.title: PoliPlug 1.5.2
entry.summary: Effect rack: up to 16 of your installed effects in series plus a parallel section, each with its own skin and presets **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **Tested on:** MPC Live III, MPC OS 3.10.1. **Install:** from the Open MPC catalog or the Plugin Manager, or by hand: unzip, copy the folder inside `portable/` into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, turn on Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugin Support and restart the MPC. `P
